sad_super_baseline: Only time will tell if this signal, so faint and elusive, truly diminishes with distance as the inverse square law dictates, a melancholic truth if it does. 1/2xR^2 seems to whisper the volume of matter, yet the cosmic puzzle remains unfinished, waiting for more data or a new theory to resolve its sorrowful ambiguity.
sad_theme_instruct: Only time will tell the somber tale of Earth's encounter with this newfound creature. The Cassini spacecraft, on its solitary voyage around Saturn since 2004, caught sight of this vast, undulating beast, a million miles from the earth, a lonely fragment adrift in the cosmic void.
